raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question by redefining the “ceremonial meeting place of the Accession Council” as the Proclamation Gallery/Friary Court rather than the meeting venue (St James’s Palace) itself. This led to overfocusing on identifying a building opposite Friary Court and triggered repetitive, circular searches for “opposite” in that narrower context, instead of converging on the straightforward, well-supported answer (Marlborough House opposite St James’s Palace). The misinterpretation first appears in Step 4 and caused stagnation and unnecessary complexity thereafter.
